# r4.1-pre.1

- Speeds up the initial remote inventory stage of synchronization by listing up to four independent folders on the same SFTP connection. Advertised server handle limits are respected; a failed limits query selects serial listing.
- Retains complete-inventory checks before transfer or deletion. Incomplete listings, invalid or ambiguous entries, cancellation, and read or close errors stop the pass rather than applying a partial inventory. Comparison rules, exclusions, upload behavior, and deletion settings are unchanged.

This targets the checking stage, particularly folder-heavy trees. Read-only diagnostics improved substantially in generated tests and one user report, but the user's file counts changed between runs; those results are not a controlled benchmark or a guarantee for every server. Normal-sync GUI timing on the user's server has not been measured.

Prerelease; stable Latest remains r4.0. Uses the existing application registration and settings. Manual installation updates the normal application; this is not a separate diagnostic-only installation.
